Loot.Title: Rewards
Loot.DropHint: Drop here what the group found: items from the sidebar, a compendium or an NPC sheet.
Loot.StatusClosed: Closed: players cannot see the rewards yet.
Loot.RevealHint: What you drop stays hidden (crossed eye) until you reveal it.

Shop.Title: Shop
Shop.FolderPlaceholder: ID or UUID of an item folder
Shop.DropHint: Drop items or a whole item folder here.

Window.EditHint: Any change clears both players' acceptance.

Chat.awaitingApproval: {first} and {second} accepted their trade. The GM must approve it.
Chat.failed: The trade between {first} and {second} could not be completed: {reason}
Chat.rejected: The GM rejected the trade between {first} and {second}.
Chat.cancelled: The trade between {first} and {second} was cancelled by {user}.
Chat.split: The GM splits the reward money between {names}.
Chat.opened: The rewards are open, help yourselves!

Errors.NoGM: A GM must be connected to handle trades.
Errors.ActorMissing: One of the trading characters no longer exists.
Errors.NotYourCharacter: You can only propose a trade with your own character.
Errors.InvalidPartner: This character cannot take part in a trade.
Errors.AlreadyTrading: A trade is already ongoing between these two characters.
Errors.ItemNotOwned: This item is not in your inventory.
Errors.ItemGone: {name} is no longer in the inventory.
Errors.EmptyTrade: Nobody gives anything in this trade.
Errors.NotAllowed: You cannot do that in this trade.
Errors.WrongStatus: This action is not possible at this stage of the trade.
Errors.NotLootable: "{name}" cannot go in the rewards: only equipment can.
Errors.LootGone: This item is no longer in the rewards.
Errors.NothingToSplit: There is not enough money to split.
Errors.ShopItemGone: This item is no longer for sale.
Errors.InvalidPrice: Unreadable price: write for example "1 GC 5 SS".
Errors.FolderNotFound: No item folder with this identifier.
Errors.LootClosed: The rewards are not open yet.

PriceUnit.Name: Unit of unitless prices
PriceUnit.Hint: Unit used when an item's price is a plain number, such as "5".

AnnounceLoot.Name: Announce rewards in the chat
AnnounceLoot.Hint: Posts a public message when the GM opens the rewards or reveals a treasure, when a player helps themselves, or when money is split.

AnnounceShop.Name: Announce purchases in the chat
AnnounceShop.Hint: Posts a public message for every purchase in a shop.
